description: This file initializes the database for a media streaming platform by creating tables and populating them with seed data such as categories, videos, and a demo user. It includes functions for idempotently creating records and checks for test environment to avoid seeding during tests.

methods.name: bool _is_test_env()
methods.description: Detects whether the current environment is for testing to prevent seeding during tests.

methods.name: None ensure_seed()
methods.description: Creates database tables and seeds demo data unless in a test environment.

methods.name: Category _get_or_create_category(db: Session, name: str)
methods.description: Idempotently fetches or creates a category with a given name.

methods.name: Video _get_or_create_video(db: Session, title: str, description: str | None, file_path: str, featured: int)
methods.description: Idempotently fetches or creates a video with a given title and attributes.

methods.name: User _get_or_create_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Idempotently fetches or creates a user with a specified email and password.

methods.name: None _seed(db: Session)
methods.description: Seeds demo categories, videos, and user data into the database.
